name: shotlist
status: Prototype · tested on one synthetic clip
mission: Shot list and Remotion template from a short video.
flowAlt: Data flow. Measured locally with ffmpeg: ffprobe reads frame rate, frame count and size, ffmpeg's scene score finds the cuts, and onsets and a tempo are detected in the decoded audio. Reading the edit: pacing statistics, one frame from the middle of each shot for its average colour, and roles, labels and the hook from Claude, or guessed from shot position without credentials. Written out: a shotlist.json checked against the schema, exported as a Remotion project with one Sequence per shot and a slot to fill for each.

nodes: share of cuts on an onset
